summary.text: IRBYGG ENTREPRENØR AS (920 405 746), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2018-01-16; address Tåsenveien 71B, 0873 OSLO, Norge. Main industry is Construction of residential and non-residential buildings (41.000); 21 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s).
